title: Incident: payment traces start from nowhere, and the fix has to make the 15:00 release

lines.text: 14:15 payments: 4% of POST /pay time out; traces for payments have no parent; release train 15:00
15:00: release train left without the fix

objective: Implement context propagation: the context API, baggage, the W3C Trace Context and Baggage propagators, and propagating across threads and services
secondaryObjectives: Configure the SDK with environment variables (OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER and others), resource detection and declarative configuration

Relevant text: OTEL_PROPAGATORS 'Default value: tracecontext,baggage'; accepted values include 'tracecontext: W3C Trace Context', 'baggage: W3C Baggage', 'b3: B3 Single'; OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER default 'parentbased_always_on'. That a service configured for B3 only does not extract a W3C traceparent follows from the propagator definitions (to verify against the propagators API page).

brief.situation: You are the observability engineer for Corrie Lane Books, a fictional online bookshop. About 4% of payments fail with a timeout. To find which downstream call is slow you need one trace from checkout through payments, but every payments trace starts as a new root with no parent. The last release train of the week leaves at 15:00; the fix for the failing call has to be on it.
handover: checkout, inventory and payments use the OpenTelemetry SDK configured by environment variables and export OTLP to the collector.
payments was moved last week from an old deployment template.
howItWorks: The terminal shows each command's output; the diagram shows the services, the trace context between them and the collector.
Each command takes a minute or two; the clock moves only when you act or wait.
When you close, you write the record and explain your reasoning.

source.note: The release train leaves at 15:00, 45 minutes after the report.

writeup.question: For the record: why the traces split, what you changed, and what the joined trace showed.

parts.label: Why
parts.criteria: Compares what checkout injects with what payments extracts.
parts.modelAnswer: checkout injects a W3C traceparent; payments' OTEL_PROPAGATORS was b3 from an old template, so it extracted nothing and started a new root for every request.

parts.label: Changed
parts.criteria: Fixes the receiving service to the shared propagators, not the sender.
parts.modelAnswer: Set payments to tracecontext,baggage, the SDK default the other services use; switching checkout to b3 would split it from inventory and the rest.

parts.label: Showed
parts.criteria: Reads the joined trace to the slow call before 15:00.
parts.modelAnswer: The joined trace put 3.0 of 3.2 s in the fraud-check partner call hitting its deadline; that fix went on the 15:00 train.

trainMissed.headline: No joined trace, no fix
trainMissed.body: Sampling and the collector decide which spans are kept and where they go. Whether payments joins checkout's trace is decided in payments, by the propagator it extracts with.

splitOthers.headline: Fixed one link by breaking the rest
splitOthers.body: inventory and the other services extract W3C traceparent. Change the one service that differs, payments, to the shared propagators.

joined.headline: Good: one propagator, one trace
joined.body: You compared what checkout sends with what payments extracts, changed only payments, read the joined trace to the slow call and checked no payments roots remained.

scoring.modelReasoning: A trace joins across a call only if the caller injects context in a format the callee extracts. payments' log shows checkout sending a W3C traceparent, and payments is configured with OTEL_PROPAGATORS=b3, left from an old template, so it extracts nothing and starts a root span for every request. Set payments to tracecontext,baggage, the SDK default the other services use; switching checkout to b3 would join this pair and split checkout from inventory and everything else. Sampling decides which traces are kept and the collector only receives spans, so neither joins them. The joined trace puts the time in the fraud-check partner call, which is the fix for the 15:00 train; confirm no payments roots remain.
